posts.title: The Master Index in July 2026
posts.deck: Wyoming holds the index; 5 states moved three places or more.
body: Wyoming holds the Master Index in July 2026, at 4.6 times the median state.
Wyoming rose 48 places to 1st, Nebraska fell 22 places to 36th, North Dakota fell 19 places to 21st, Kansas rose 17 places to 9th, and South Dakota fell 15 places to 45th, against July 2025.
50 states are ranked in this month.
